in_the_box.source_title: P2S Packaging List | Bambu Lab Wiki
in_the_box.caveat: Official packing list of the new P2S Combo; the wiki says "The type and quantity of accessories may vary." The refurbished page says the unit is "Repackaged with all the original accessories" and its own box list (P2S, AMS 2 Pro, Filament Buffer, Buildplate, Accessory Box, Spool Holder) agrees at top level.
